audit.whatIsWrong: Chart gave Yorick levels 2, 3 and first item while the matching whys describe Sylas hooking him off cooldown, bullying his melee pattern, and out-sustaining ghoul chip — on a 55.5% win rate. whys[4] calls level 6 'the biggest tempo swing of the entire game' yet the row read Skill. Packet chart reads Skill, Sylas, Sylas, Sylas, Sylas, Sylas, Yorick.
audit.why: Yorick's lane strength is chip and shove, not burst; once Sylas has E he chooses when the fight happens. Yorick only takes over at two items when the Maiden splits independently.
audit.corrected: Rows 1-5 flipped to Sylas in both layers with ratings rescaled; row 6 left with Yorick.

audit.why: Four spikes at level 2, level 6, first item and late — all real timings, and the level 6 Hijack is correctly identified as the peak window given Yorick's own R is 160 seconds at rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: The early text calls his passive 'Omen of Death'; the passive is Shepherd of Souls (Omen of Death is not in his kit at all). Mourning Mist is described only as a slow — Riot's text says it reduces armour and marks the target, and summoned units gain move speed toward marked targets, none of which is on the page. Last Rites' auto-attack reset is never mentioned. Dark Procession is called a 'fifteen-second' window when it is 20/18/16/14/12.
audit.why: The armour shred plus the mark-chase is the actual reason being caught by the mist inside the cage is fatal — the page presented it as a slow you could walk out of. And a wrong passive name is the exact class of error this audit exists to catch.
audit.corrected: Shepherd of Souls named correctly; Mourning Mist's armour shred and mark stated; Last Rites named as an auto-reset; Dark Procession stated at 20 seconds at rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page states two different and incompatible things about Kingslayer's healing: the mid text says 'your W heal scales on his missing health', while wants.you[1] says 'low HP means maximum heal' (yours). Riot's text says only that it heals Sylas when it hits enemy champions.
audit.why: One of the two is necessarily wrong, and a player builds their commit timing around whichever they read. Rather than pick, I removed both scaling claims and stated only what the kit supports — that the heal comes off hitting Yorick himself, not off the ghouls.
audit.corrected: Both scaling claims replaced with 'Kingslayer heals you off Yorick himself'.

audit.why: Packet reported no suspect names and Sylas's own ability names (Chain Lash, Kingslayer, Abscond/Abduct) are used correctly throughout.

edits.before: At level 1 you only have Q or W and Yorick's Omen of Death passive lets him kill a minion to spawn a ghoul — don't step into ghoul-swarm range or you take free chip damage with no reliable trade back. Farm from max Q range and accept that he shoves early. The moment you hit level 2 and E is available, look for a hook the instant his Mourning Mist E is on cooldown: if you land Abduct before his slow applies, you pull yourself onto him and W Kingslayer fires before any ghoul leash reaches you.
edits.after: At level 1 you only have Q or W and Yorick's Shepherd of Souls passive lets him raise Mist Walkers off graves — don't step into swarm range or you take free chip damage with no reliable trade back. Farm from max Q range and accept that he shoves early. The moment you hit level 2 and E is available, look for a hook the instant Mourning Mist is on cooldown — 12 seconds at rank 1 — because if you Abduct before the mist marks you, W Kingslayer fires before any ghoul reaches you.

edits.before: Levels 3 through 5 are your safest sustained-trade window. Your W heal scales on his missing health, and Yorick's kit is front-loaded damage through ghoul swarms — extended fights favour you because you heal back what the ghouls chip. The one thing that beats you here is his W cage: if he walls you inside Dark Procession, Mourning Mist hits a slowed you and the Maiden shreds freely. Always watch his W cast animation and dash out with E first dash before the wall closes. At 6, steal Eulogy of the Isles immediately — you want to all-in him while he has no Maiden buffer, and your stolen Maiden fights alongside your chain-passive autos for a near-free kill.
edits.after: Levels 3 through 5 are your safest sustained-trade window. Kingslayer heals you off Yorick himself, and his damage comes through the swarm — extended fights favour you because every W into him refunds what the ghouls chip. The one thing that beats you is his cage: walled inside Dark Procession you eat a Mourning Mist that shreds your armour and marks you, and marked targets pull the swarm in faster. Watch the cast and dash clear with E1 before the wall closes — it is 20 seconds at rank 1. Last Rites is an auto-reset, so read the wind-up, not the swing. At 6, steal Eulogy of the Isles and all-in while he has no Maiden buffer.

edits.before: Your W heal keeps you healthy through ghoul swarms and you can dodge his W wall with first-tap E — force trades whenever Dark Procession is on cooldown.
edits.after: Kingslayer heals off Yorick himself and E1 dashes clear of the cage — force trades whenever Dark Procession is down, and that is 20 seconds at rank 1.

edits.before: Trade through his W cage with W Kingslayer healing — low HP means maximum heal just as his ghouls ramp up
edits.after: Never trade inside Dark Procession — caged, the mist shreds your armour and the swarm gets free hits

edits.before: Land Mourning Mist E before you commit so the ghoul swarm hits a slowed target
edits.after: Land Mourning Mist first — it shreds armour and marks you, so the swarm speeds up

edits.before: Yorick burns Dark Procession (Cage) on nothing — take the fifteen-second invitation.
edits.after: Yorick burns Dark Procession (Cage) on nothing — take the twenty-second invitation.

notes: 'Omen of Death' is not a Yorick ability — his passive is Shepherd of Souls — and that was the page's factual anchor for the entire level 1 explanation. Mourning Mist's armour shred and the mark that speeds his summons toward you were both missing; the page described only a slow, which understates why being caged is lethal. I also found the page contradicting itself on Kingslayer's heal scaling (mid said it scales on Yorick's missing health, wants.you[1] said it scales on yours); Riot's text supports neither, so I removed both rather than pick a side — flagged in questionsForUser.
